## QR Code Generator

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live preview</span></div>

Generate QR codes from text or URLs as PNG and SVG with size, error correction, margin and colors.

```sh
dogubako dev qr-generate <text> [options]
```

Id `dev.qr_generate` · MCP `dev_qr_generate` · Output: files · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: qr, qr code, generate, barcode, url, wifi, 2d code

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) |  | Content. |
| `size` | `--size` | integer 64–4096 | `512` | Image size in pixels. |
| `error_correction` | `--error-correction` | choice | `M` | One of: `L` (Low (7%)), `M` (Medium (15%)), `Q` (Quartile (25%)), `H` (High (30%)). |
| `margin` | `--margin` | integer 0–20 | `4` | Quiet zone in modules (4 recommended). |
| `foreground` | `--foreground` | color | `#000000` |  |
| `background` | `--background` | color | `#ffffff` |  |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `both` | One of: `both` (PNG + SVG), `png`, `svg`. *Advanced.* |
| `file_name` | `--file-name` | text | `qr-code` | *Advanced.* |

## Base64 Encode / Decode

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Encode text or files to Base64 (standard or URL-safe, with or without padding, data URI) and decode Base64 back to text or a file.

```sh
dogubako dev base64 [text] [options]
```

Id `dev.base64` · MCP `dev_base64` · Output: text (`text/plain`) · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: base64, encode, decode, data uri, base64url, atob, btoa

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `--mode` | choice | `encode` | One of: `encode`, `decode`. |
| `text` | positional | text (multi-line) |  | Text / Base64. |
| `file` | `--file` | file |  | Or a file to encode. Only used when `mode` is `encode`. |
| `url_safe` | `--url-safe` | boolean | `false` | URL-safe alphabet (- and \_). Only used when `mode` is `encode`. |
| `no_padding` | `--no-padding` | boolean | `false` | Omit = padding. Only used when `mode` is `encode`. |
| `data_uri` | `--data-uri` | boolean | `false` | Output as data: URI. Only used when `mode` is `encode`. *Advanced.* |
| `wrap` | `--wrap` | integer 0–1000 | `0` | Wrap lines at (0 = no wrapping, 76 = MIME). Only used when `mode` is `encode`. *Advanced.* |
| `output` | `--output` | choice | `auto` | Decoded output. One of: `auto` (Text if possible, else file), `text`, `file`. Only used when `mode` is `decode`. |
